page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v.6xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance engineered for high-throughput parallel processing and compute-intensive enterprise workloads. Powered by the Intel Xeon 8469C processor clocked at 2.6 GHz, the system provides 24 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs backed by 128 GB of system memory, establishing an allocation of 5.33 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by a single dedicated GPU equipped with 96 GB of video memory (VRAM). This large VRAM footprint accommodates substantial parameter sets, high-resolution rendering frames, and extensive batch processing in memory. Networking is provisioned with a 15 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, supporting consistent host communication and data pipeline throughput.

The instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring network-attached cloud disks for persistent storage operations. It also provisions zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses by default. Architectural tradeoffs emphasize accelerator memory density and host compute over local scratch space, making the configuration well matched for large-scale deep learning inference, model evaluation, visual computing, and scientific simulations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v.6xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance built for demanding accelerated computing tasks. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8469C processor running at 2.6 GHz, the server provides 24 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs alongside 128 GB of system memory, establishing a balanced ratio of 5.33 GB per core. Acceleration is driven by a single integrated GPU featuring 96 GB of dedicated VRAM, accommodating large-scale model weights and memory-heavy parallel computations. For data movement, the system includes a 15 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance features no local storage and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating external block storage for primary disk operations. The combination of high VRAM capacity and 24 dedicated host cores positions ecs.gn8v.6xlarge for deep learning inference, AI model serving, high-performance data processing, and visual rendering pipelines.
